description: This file defines the CurlyRouter struct and its methods for routing HTTP requests based on URL path patterns with parameters in curly brackets, including regex matching and web service detection.

classes.name: CurlyRouter
classes.description: Router implementation that matches routes with curly-bracket parameters and regex support.

methods.name: SelectRoute
methods.description: Selects the best route for a given HTTP request from a list of web services.

methods.name: selectRoutes
methods.description: Returns routes from a WebService that match the request path tokens.

methods.name: matchesRouteByPathTokens
methods.description: Checks if route tokens match request tokens, counting parameters and static parts.

methods.name: regularMatchesPathToken
methods.description: Matches a route token with regex against a request token, with caching support.

methods.name: detectRoute
methods.description: Detects the route matching the request, considering headers.

methods.name: detectWebService
methods.description: Finds the best matching web service based on path tokens.

methods.name: computeWebserviceScore
methods.description: Scores how well request tokens match route tokens for web service detection.
